item.content:encoded:
Schedule Your Appointment at Our 5-Star Rated Dental Practice

Dr. Zaidi and the team of Chapel Hill Dental Arts are appreciative of receiving over 1000 five star reviews on Google! We value the feedback of our existing patients and encourage new patients to join the Chapel Hill Dental Arts family. Click the badge below to read our reviews. Book an Appointment Patient Testimonials

What Our Patients Say

[trustindex no-registration=google]Trustindex rating score: 5.0 of 5, based on 1,390 reviews Questions / Schedule An Appointment

Contact Us

  • 429 Highway 35, Red Bank, NJ 07701

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: tntadmin
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://chapelhilldentalarts.com.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: tntadmin
item.content:encoded:
About Our Middletown Dental Practice

Meet Our Doctors

Expert & Experienced

Meet Dr. Asim Zaidi

Doctor of Medicine in Dentistry

Asim Zaidi DMD is a graduate of Rutgers University with a BS in Hospital and Health Administration/Public Health and a 1997 graduate of UMDNJ in General Dentistry. 

Dr. Zaidi started his full service practice 20 years ago. He is a member of the ADA, The American Association of Cosmetic Dentistry and currently serves on the NJ Board of The Academy of General Dentists. 

 He has received extensive training in the All on 4 Surgical and Restorative Technique, attended multiple workshops at the Spear Training Institute for continuing education and has been recognized as a high level Gold Provider for Straumann Implants. 

He has also received the Crest Award for Excellence in Dentistry for the Elderly. The success of the practice is based on Dr. Zaidi's insistence that patients be provided with real-world affordable solutions for a beautiful smile.

Meet Dr. Kristen Blumberger

DMD - Middletown, NJ

Dr. Kristen Blumberger grew up in Little Silver, NJ. After receiving an academic scholarship for scholastic achievement, she graduated from Tulane University with a B.S. in Exercise Science with a concentration in Kinesiology. She went on to attend Tufts University School of Dental Medicine, receiving both the Hunt and Merit scholarships for scholastic achievement.

After graduating from dental school, Dr. Blumberger completed a one-year General Practice Residency at St. Lukes-Roosevelt Hospital in Manhattan. From 2001-2005 she practiced general dentistry in NYC and has also served as an adjunct clinical instructor at NYU College of Dentistry, In 2004 she received the Appreciation Award for Dedication to the Advancement of NYU College of Dentistry from the Student National Dental Association. Dr. Blumberger enjoys volunteering.

In 2003 she set up dental clinics in underprivileged areas of the Dominican Republic. In 2004 she went on another outreach trip to Jamaica, where she volunteered and performed dental work in rural communities with NYU College of Dentistry. Dr. Blumberger went on to complete a 2-year post-graduate residency program in Endodontics at NYU College of Dentistry, graduating in 2007. During her residency she worked on research with respect to pain management and pain medications. Dr. Blumberger currently works as an endodontist in NYC and NJ, where her main focus is easing patients anxiety and performing painless root canals.

Meet Dr. Steven Reff

DDS Specializing in Dental Implants and Teeth In A Day

Meet the Team

At Chapel Hill Dental Arts, our exceptional team is at the heart of everything we do. From the moment you walk through our doors, our friendly staff is here to ensure you feel welcome, comfortable, and well-cared for. Whether you’re scheduling an appointment, discussing treatment options, or receiving care in the dental chair, every member of our team is committed to providing a seamless and positive experience.Our skilled dental assistants, hygienists, and administrative professionals work closely with our dentists and specialists to deliver comprehensive care under one roof. With expertise across all aspects of dentistry, our team collaborates to meet your unique oral health needs and help you achieve the smile you’ve always wanted.We take pride in creating a warm, supportive environment for all of our patients and look forward to being a part of your dental journey.

Office Tour

At Chapel Hill Dental Arts, we believe that your dental experience starts the moment you step into our office. Our modern, welcoming space has been thoughtfully designed to provide a comfortable and relaxing environment for all patients. From our state-of-the-art treatment rooms to our cozy waiting area, every detail is intended to make your visit stress-free and enjoyable.

We invite you to take a virtual tour of our office and explore the spaces where we provide top-quality care. Whether it’s for routine cleanings or advanced procedures, our facility is equipped with the latest dental technology to ensure efficient, effective treatments.

Scroll through the slideshow besides to see where your smile transformation begins!

In-House Lab

At Chapel Hill Dental Arts, our in-house lab sets us apart by ensuring faster, more precise dental restorations for our patients. From custom dental implants and same-day dentures to crowns and veneers, having a fully equipped lab on-site allows us to deliver high-quality results without the delays that come from outsourcing.With the convenience of both our specialists and lab technicians working under one roof, we can streamline your care and make adjustments on the spot—saving you time and ensuring every restoration is tailored to your needs. Whether you’re receiving cosmetic enhancements or restorative treatments, our in-house lab plays a critical role in helping us achieve exceptional outcomes and beautiful smiles.

Asim Zaidi DMD is a graduate of Rutgers University with a BS in Hospital and Health Administration\/Public Health and a 1997 graduate of UMDNJ in General Dentistry.\u00a0<\/p>

Dr. Zaidi started his full service practice 20 years ago. He is a member of the ADA, The American Association of Cosmetic Dentistry and currently serves on the NJ Board of The Academy of General Dentists.\u00a0<\/p>

\u00a0He has received extensive training in the All on 4 Surgical and Restorative Technique, attended multiple workshops at the Spear Training Institute for continuing education and has been recognized as a high level Gold Provider for Straumann Implants.\u00a0<\/p>

He has also received the Crest Award for Excellence in Dentistry for the Elderly. Dr. Kristen Blumberger grew up in Little Silver, NJ. After receiving an academic scholarship for scholastic achievement, she graduated from Tulane University with a B.S. in Exercise Science with a concentration in Kinesiology. She went on to attend Tufts University School of Dental Medicine, receiving both the Hunt and Merit scholarships for scholastic achievement.<\/p>

After graduating from dental school, Dr. Blumberger completed a one-year General Practice Residency at St. Lukes-Roosevelt Hospital in Manhattan. From 2001-2005 she practiced general dentistry in NYC and has also served as an adjunct clinical instructor at NYU College of Dentistry, In 2004 she received the Appreciation Award for Dedication to the Advancement of NYU College of Dentistry from the Student National Dental Association. Dr. Blumberger enjoys volunteering.<\/p>

In 2003 she set up dental clinics in underprivileged areas of the Dominican Republic. In 2004 she went on another outreach trip to Jamaica, where she volunteered and performed dental work in rural communities with NYU College of Dentistry. Dr. Blumberger went on to complete a 2-year post-graduate residency program in Endodontics at NYU College of Dentistry, graduating in 2007. During her residency she worked on research with respect to pain management and pain medications. Dr. Blumberger currently works as an endodontist in NYC and NJ, where her main focus is easing patients anxiety and performing painless root canals.<\/p>"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":true}],"isInner":true},{"id":"1a24941","elType":"widget","settings":{"text":"Divider","weight":{"unit":"px","size":5,"sizes":[]},"gap":{"unit":"px","size":0,"sizes":[]},"__globals__":{"color":"globals\/colors?id=06b4152"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"divider"},{"id":"fee464c","elType":"container","settings":{"content_width":"full","flex_direction":"row","background_background":"classic","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"f94ca2b"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"80901ae"}],"__globals__":{"background_color":""},"padding_mobile":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":true}},"elements":[{"id":"6131683","elType":"container","settings":{"content_width":"full","width":{"unit":"%","size":40,"sizes":[]},"hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"d33c1a9"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"61ccc74"}]},"elements":[{"id":"316c0d5","elType":"widget","settings":{"image":{"url":"https:\/\/chapelhilldentalarts.com\/wp-content\/uploads\/2024\/11\/Dr.-Reff-edited--scaled.jpg","id":466,"size":"","alt":"","source":"library"},"width":{"unit":"%","size":100,"sizes":[]},"object-fit":"cover"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"image"}],"isInner":true},{"id":"54da5e0","elType":"container","settings":{"content_width":"full","width":{"unit":"%","size":60,"sizes":[]},"flex_justify_content":"center","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ef9c7a7"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"b20f91d"}]},"elements":[{"id":"8d02d1d","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Meet New Dental Patients Middletown

Welcome New Dental Patients!

We are delighted to welcome you to Chapel Hill Dental Arts, where we offer comprehensive dental care under one roof. 

From routine cleanings to complex restorative treatments, we strive to make your experience comfortable and convenient. To help you prepare for your first visit at our office in Middletown, we’ve gathered all the essential information you need on one page.

Patient Information

Your journey to a healthy, beautiful smile begins with scheduling an appointment.
  • Call us at 732-365-0123 or schedule online to request an appointment.
  • When scheduling, please provide a brief description of your dental needs to help us serve you better.

Emergency Appointments

We do our best to accommodate patients with toothaches or emergencies the same day they call. If needed, follow-up appointments will ensure your treatment is completed seamlessly.

Office Policies

  • If you need to cancel or reschedule your appointment, we ask for 24 hours' notice to avoid any charges for missed appointments.
  • Our friendly staff is available to assist with any questions regarding your health history or special needs during your visit.

Payment Options

We aim to make dental care as accessible as possible by accepting various payment methods:

  • Cash, personal checks, and money orders
  • Major credit cards: Visa, MasterCard, Discover, and American Express

Insurance

We participate in most major dental insurance programs, including:

  • Delta Dental
  • Cigna
  • Aetna
  • Horizon
  • Metlife

Our staff will handle the submission of insurance claims on your behalf. Please note that your co-pay is due at the time of service, and any remaining balance is your responsibility if insurance covers less than expected. If needed, we can provide a pre-treatment estimate to help you understand what your insurance will cover.

Financing Options

We are proud to offer CareCredit, which provides flexible 0% interest financing for up to six months. This allows you to receive the care you need now and pay over time without incurring additional interest charges.

Smile Protection Plan

Ask about our Smile Protection Plan—a unique program designed to make dental treatments more affordable for our patients.

Contact our team for more information on how to enroll.

Patient Forms

Save time at your first appointment by completing our new patient forms in advance.Download the forms below, fill them out at home, and bring them with you to your visit. Download Forms

Educational Dental Videos

At Chapel Hill Dental Arts, we believe in empowering our patients with knowledge to make informed decisions about their oral health.
